summary: Shadow evidence is mixed but leans toward near-term pullback and continued ETH/BTC relative weakness. The strongest aligned signals are persistent ETH/BTC failure below 0.03, weak breadth, negative latest spot-flow imbalances, BTC funding repricing and downside option skew. Confidence is degraded by unavailable 1-hour and 4-hour anchors, a non-informative 12-hour row, positive 72-hour asset returns, declining open interest, and incomplete historical comparisons. Forecasts are unratified research candidates only.
